verdict.rationale: Obsidian's documented design stores notes as plain Markdown files locally on the user's device, in folders the user picks as vaults (obsidian-docs-2, obsidian-docs-20, obsidian-docs-39). Users also choose the sync backend, whether Obsidian Sync, Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive or Git (obsidian-docs-19), which gives direct control over where data resides; a community user confirms notes live only on their machine and chosen sync service (obsidian-comm-9). missing for 10: no evidence of region or data-residency selection for Obsidian's own hosted services (Sync servers, Publish hosting), no formal residency or compliance documentation.
